note: collapseContexts(ifWithoutElse(Qty in context Order, Tag in context Orders)) onto All: the condition has two contexts, one per Order, the value one in all. o1: Tag x, Line (a, true); o2: Line (b, true). The result has as many contexts as the then input: context 1 pairs true with x, and o2's true condition has no value context, so there is no context 2 and no second All (fn/ifWithoutElse/009 is the other way round: a value context beyond the condition's last gives an empty context).
